api document of method normalize(Message:
* Creates a normalized copy of this message by following xNAME chains, synthesizing CNAMEs from * DNAMEs if necessary, and removing illegal RRsets from {@link Section#AUTHORITY} and {@link * Section#ADDITIONAL}. * *

Normalization is only applied to {@link Rcode#NOERROR} and {@link Rcode#NXDOMAIN} responses. * *

This method is equivalent to calling {@link #normalize(Message, boolean)} with {@code * false}. * * @param query The query that produced this message. * @return {@code null} if the message could not be normalized or is otherwise invalid. * @since 3.6
